intensive.name: Intensive
intensive.audience: Best for beginners and anyone who wants weekly follow-up with Zoom calls: training + nutrition + Zoom + one in-person session.
items: One free in-person session (1 hour) to correct technique and check exercise quality (women, Eastern Province)
A full training and nutrition plan with clear exercise guides, at home or in the gym
4 Zoom calls a month to review your progress and your training and mindset questions
A weekly review of your physical and mental progress (video or voice note), adjusting calories or training when needed
A simple guide to the MyFitnessPal calorie-tracking app
A complete training and nutrition booklet
Help choosing what suits your health and lifestyle in nutrition and daily routine
Daily contact, with replies within 48 working hours
intensive.delivery: A personalised program file after the questionnaire, regular reviews by video or voice note, and daily contact on WhatsApp with replies within 48 working hours.
intensive.requirements: Fill in the trainee questionnaire (5 steps), then transfer by bank and upload a photo of the receipt. The subscription starts once the transfer is verified and the questionnaire is complete.
intensive.policy_note: Paid once per plan and duration by bank transfer, with no automatic renewal. 3-month subscriptions are covered by the conditional money-back guarantee and the free renewal for consistent trainees.

advanced.name: Advanced
advanced.audience: For experienced trainees who want training + nutrition with weekly follow-up, without Zoom.
items: A full training and nutrition plan with clear exercise guides, at home or in the gym
A weekly review of your physical and mental progress (video or voice note), adjusting calories or training when needed
A complete training and nutrition booklet
Help choosing what suits your health and lifestyle in training and daily routine
Daily contact, with replies within 48 working hours
Zoom calls and the in-person session (Intensive only)
advanced.delivery: A personalised program file after the questionnaire, regular reviews by video or voice note, and daily contact on WhatsApp with replies within 48 working hours.
advanced.requirements: Fill in the trainee questionnaire (5 steps), then transfer by bank and upload a photo of the receipt. The subscription starts once the transfer is verified and the questionnaire is complete.
advanced.policy_note: Paid once per plan and duration by bank transfer, with no automatic renewal. 3-month subscriptions are covered by the conditional money-back guarantee and the free renewal for consistent trainees.

basic.name: Basic
basic.audience: For anyone who manages their own nutrition and needs a training plan only, with a review every two weeks.
items: A full training plan with clear exercise guides, at home or in the gym
A review every two weeks of your physical and mental progress (video or voice note), adjusting training when needed
A complete training and nutrition booklet
Daily contact, with replies within 48 working hours
No nutrition plan
basic.delivery: A personalised program file after the questionnaire, regular reviews by video or voice note, and daily contact on WhatsApp with replies within 48 working hours.
basic.requirements: Fill in the trainee questionnaire (5 steps), then transfer by bank and upload a photo of the receipt. The subscription starts once the transfer is verified and the questionnaire is complete.
basic.policy_note: Paid once per plan and duration by bank transfer, with no automatic renewal. 3-month subscriptions are covered by the conditional money-back guarantee and the free renewal for consistent trainees.

nutrition.name: Nutrition
nutrition.audience: For anyone who needs a complete nutrition plan and wants to learn calorie counting, without a training plan.
nutrition.note: One month · usually no renewal needed
items: A complete nutrition plan that fits your goal and lifestyle
Your calorie target for your goal
Learning calorie counting, with food choices that suit you
An Excel file to track progress and measurements
A weekly discussion of your relationship with food at home and out
Daily contact, with replies within 48 working hours
Not needed if you are on Intensive or Advanced: nutrition is included there
nutrition.delivery: A personalised program file after the questionnaire, regular reviews by video or voice note, and daily contact on WhatsApp with replies within 48 working hours.
nutrition.requirements: Fill in the trainee questionnaire (5 steps), then transfer by bank and upload a photo of the receipt. The subscription starts once the transfer is verified and the questionnaire is complete.
nutrition.policy_note: Paid once by bank transfer, with no automatic renewal. The money-back guarantee covers 3-month subscriptions to Intensive, Advanced, and Basic only.

custom-training-plan.name: Personal-training alternative
custom-training-plan.audience: For advanced trainees who do not need follow-up, or as a cheaper alternative to personal training.
items: A custom training plan for the number of training days you need
How to gauge effort and the number of sets required
Download the plan to your device
custom-training-plan.delivery: A personalised plan after the questionnaire, delivered as a file you can download to your device. No follow-up.
custom-training-plan.requirements: Fill in the trainee questionnaire (5 steps), then transfer by bank and upload a photo of the receipt. The subscription starts once the transfer is verified and the questionnaire is complete.
custom-training-plan.policy_note: Paid once by bank transfer. The plans are yours for life and you can edit them.

training-nutrition-plan.name: Training plan with nutrition

Download the plan to your device

nutrition-consultation.name: Nutrition consultation
nutrition-consultation.audience: For specific nutrition questions: one session is enough to set your calories and food advice.
items: Discuss all your nutrition questions
A calorie target for your goal with food suggestions
Advice on supplements and how to eat out the right way
nutrition-consultation.delivery: A session on Google Meet or WhatsApp, whichever suits you.
nutrition-consultation.requirements: Fill in the trainee questionnaire (5 steps), then transfer by bank and upload a photo of the receipt. The subscription starts once the transfer is verified and the questionnaire is complete.

Adjust your training plan to your goal, with mobility exercise suggestions
Correct the technique of exercises you suspect are wrong or cause pain
Check that your training quality is right for building muscle
